nodes.name: Intuit Webhook
nodes.notes: Register this node's PRODUCTION URL (workflow must be Active) in the Intuit Developer portal → Webhooks, subscribed to Payment events. Intuit needs a 2xx within ~3s, so the node answers immediately and processing continues afterwards. Keep Options → Raw Body ON: the signature is computed over the exact bytes.

nodes.name: Split Payment Entities
nodes.notes: Set ERP_BASE_URL / QBO_API_BASE here or as n8n Variables ILL_ERP_BASE_URL / QBO_API_BASE. Use the sandbox API base only with an Intuit sandbox company.

nodes.name: Fetch QBO Payment
nodes.notes: Select your QuickBooks OAuth2 credential (production company). Failures (e.g. payment deleted before we fetched it, expired QBO connection) go to the alert branch.

nodes.name: POST to ERPNext
nodes.notes: Guest + HMAC endpoint — no ERPNext API key. The body must be the exact signed string (raw body), never re-serialized JSON. Retries only cover network failures; ERPNext is idempotent, so re-running an execution is safe.

nodes.name: Send Alert (replace with Slack/Email)
nodes.notes: Swap this for a Slack or Send Email node using {{ $json.subject }} / {{ $json.text }}. Also set Workflow Settings → Error Workflow so a bad signature or config error isn't silent.
